description: Main window, LOCAL context only (the window is a remote loopback URL, so this grants the page nothing). The IPC the SPA actually needs — updater/relaunch, the storage-location get/set commands, and the folder-picker dialog — is granted at runtime, scoped to the exact http://127.0.0.1:<port> origin — see grant_spa_update_ipc in src/lib.rs.
